{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Check if any such customers exist
print("Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH:", len(filtered_df))

# Check if 'converted' is binary (0 or 1)
print("Unique values in 'converted':", sorted(filtered_df['converted'].unique()))

# Compute conversion rate: fraction who converted
conversion_rate = filtered_df['converted'].mean()

# Print the result
conversion_rate"}
